extension.summary: Your subtitle interpreter: translates subtitles into your language while the video keeps playing
extension.description:
When a subtitle is loaded during playback (picked in the subtitle dialog, downloaded automatically by a subtitle add-on, or found next to the video), Dragoman translates it into your language with Google Gemini and switches to the translation when it is ready. Playback never pauses. Subtitles already in your language, or in languages you choose to leave alone, are not translated. Works for streams and local files on any Kodi 19+ device.
You need your own free Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Type it in, or import it from a web address such as an unlisted Pastebin paste. Only the subtitle text, the title, the plot and the cast names are sent; timings stay on your device.
Privacy: subtitle text, titles, plots and cast names are sent to Google. On Gemini's free tier, Google may use this content to improve its products.
A dragoman was the interpreter who stood between travellers and the language around them.
extension.disclaimer: Subtitle text, titles, plots and cast names are sent to Google for translation. On the free tier Google may use them to improve its products. Machine translation can contain mistakes.
extension.news: v0.5.0 - Male and female forms, done properly: before translating, Dragoman works out who says each line and to whom (a separate, more careful pass over whole scenes), so every line goes to Gemini marked with the speaker's and listener's gender, and a character keeps the same gender all the way through. The translation is then checked on your device: "I"/"you" forms that contradict it (Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian, Slovenian, Czech, Slovak, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian) are sent back once to be fixed. A film takes a minute or two longer; Settings > Gemini > "Work out who speaks to whom first" turns it off. Subtitles translated before are translated again once. v0.4.1 - Works next to Subterra: subtitles from add-ons that translate by themselves are left to them (Subterra from the start; Settings > Subtitles from other add-ons to ignore). Latin American Spanish (es-419, Spanish (LatAm)) and other regional variants count as the language itself, so they are not translated again. v0.4.0 - Timing. Sync assistant: during playback open Subtitles > Download > Dragoman, pick a line and press OK when you hear it - once fixes a delay, twice (later in the film) fixes drift too. Subtitles made for a different frame rate (they drift further off as the film goes on) are spotted, and Dragoman asks before fixing them (Settings > Timing). Fixes, Undo and "no" are remembered for that video and subtitle, also for its translations.

extension.summary: Installs Dragoman and keeps it up to date
extension.description: The home of Dragoman, the subtitle interpreter: it translates subtitles into your language with Google Gemini while the video keeps playing. Install Dragoman from this repository and Kodi updates it automatically.
